consumers.justification: Owns the aggregate lifecycle, projects capability contexts, and applies explicit outcomes.
Provides the single typed constructor boundary for the internal aggregate.
Publishes final results and commits approved aggregate-owned completion state.
Builds the aggregate once from validated GitHub Action inputs and composition facts.
Dispatches the aggregate only to the selected top-level route handler.
Owns outer lifecycle logging, queue failure handling, and top-level route completion.
Defines the closed top-level route-handler boundary used by the entrypoint dispatcher.
Coordinates the push route and projects every leaf capability request.
Coordinates issue and pull-request conversation comments and projects leaf requests.
Coordinates the issue route and applies explicit branch-configuration outcomes.
Coordinates review-comment commands and projects bounded Bugbot operations.
Coordinates the pull-request route and projects its workflow context.
Dispatches the closed single-action command union to credential-free capability contexts.
